   - Escaped characters (backslash escapes)
   - Nested brackets that are properly balanced

def parse_link_text(src: str, pos: int) ->Union[Tuple[str, int], Tuple[None,
    None]]:
    """Parse link text, handling nested brackets."""
    depth = 1
    i = pos
    
    while i < len(src):
        m = _INLINE_SQUARE_BRACKET_RE.search(src, i)
        if not m:
            # No more brackets found
            return None, None
        
        # Get the bracket character
        bracket_pos = m.end() - 1
        bracket_char = src[bracket_pos]
        
        if bracket_char == '[':
            depth += 1
        elif bracket_char == ']':
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                # Found the matching closing bracket
                text = src[pos:bracket_pos]
                return text, bracket_pos + 1
